Define various testing strategies, including manual and API testing

Minimum of 4 years of experience in software testing
Knowledge of Agile testing methodologies
Experience with testing tools such as Octane, Jira, and Postman/Bruno 
Knowledge of programming languages such as Java 
Knowledge of testing standards and methodologies (ISTQB etc.)
Ability to work effectively within a team and communicate clearly and efficiently
 Skills : 
Functional and technical testing
